content: In the first experiment, we evaluated the DL and ML methods on SNLI, multi-NLI, Quora, and Clinical-QE. For the datasets that did not have a development and test sets, we randomly selected two sets, each amounting to 10% of the data, for test and development, and used the remaining 80% for training. For MultiNLI, we used the dev1-matched set for validation and the dev2-mismatched set for testing.
